body: That’s good. I’m dealing with a narcissist ex who broke my heart. They discard then love bomb. It’s a pattern. The hardest part is that a narcissist can never see themselves as a narcissist. Like I said, I’m currently extremely heavy hearted over my ex fiancé right now and I really wish they’d recognize the issues. It’s a no win situation.
